product.title: Fill My Building
product.summary: Price an arena for a season and watch the demand curve answer back.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students set ticket prices, concession markup, parking and special events month by month across a season, watching attendance and revenue respond — raise prices too far and the building empties and revenue falls with it — ending in a season grade.
product.technology: single-file HTML/CSS/JS with a grade-band toggle

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.

governance.maturityBasis: A complete short-format experience and one of the clearest demonstrations of elasticity in the portfolio. Not deployed, and no student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: No deployment found for this repo (GitHub Pages 404).
knownBlockers: No deployment — an instructor cannot run it today.

provenance.evidence: BSC-anythingelse/public/fill-my-building.html: 'the demand curve is real: raise prices too much → attendance drops → revenue drops', with a grade-band toggle.
